flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminui src/utils/models/Iwarrantofarrest.d.ts (type declaration only), pages/NoticeSearch/hook/{useSearch.ts,useSearchParams.tsx} (search by warrant_no), pages/NoticeSearch/form/NoticeSearchAllForm.tsx; ocmsadminapi api-authorization.properties (path list only). No entity/controller/service/cron for warrant of arrest in any of the six repos.
note: The story asks OCMS to send warrant update requests to State Courts. There is no code for recording warrant outcomes, selecting unsent warrants, building the request, sending to State Courts, or marking as sent. There is no entity, repository, controller, service, cron or SFTP/API client for Warrant of Arrest in ocmsadminapi, ocmsadminprivateapi, thirdpartyapi or ocmseserviceapi (case-insensitive grep: warrant, woa, state court, send_to_sc, roms_error, warrantofarrest, woc_number; synonyms court mention/trial/outcome also checked). The only traces are the TypeScript type Iwarrantofarrest in ocmsadminui and a GET call to endpoint 'warrantofarrest' used to search notices; the path /v1/warrantofarrest is in the authorization list but no controller or entity serves it. The CAS inbound endpoints in CasIntegrationController (casGetPaymentStatus, casUpdateCourtNotices, plus-get-court-case-info, plus-payment-activation) are not credited: they are calls from CAS/PLUS to OCMS about court notices, not warrant updates to/from State Courts. Story status is blank in the data (no URA status).
recommendation: Do not claim. The feature does not exist in the six repos; ask URA/the team in which repo the court module (warrant, State Courts SFTP) was built, or mark it as a gap.

steps.step: Officer records or updates the warrant of arrest outcome in OCMS
steps.detail: Only a TypeScript type Iwarrantofarrest exists (fields outcome_of_warrant, warrant_status_flg, etc., Iwarrantofarrest.d.ts:1-40). There is no form, page or API in ocmsadminui to record or update a warrant outcome; ocmsadminapi has no warrantofarrest entity/controller (grep 0 hits in src). The path /v1/warrantofarrest only appears in api-authorization.properties:23 with no handler.

steps.step: OCMS selects warrants not yet sent to build a request
steps.detail: send_to_sc_flag / send_to_sc_date only appear as fields in the UI type (Iwarrantofarrest.d.ts:21-22). No cron, query or repository reads this flag in ocmsadminprivateapi/src or ocmsadminapi/src (grep send_to_sc, warrant: 0 hits).

steps.step: OCMS builds the warrant update request in the State Courts format
steps.detail: There is no warrant file/payload generator. The only backend mention is a comment that the 'Court module not ready for MVP1' on the Warrant Description column of the Toppan file (AgencyFileExchangeServiceImpl.java:727), which is not a request to State Courts. ToppanUploadHelper.getWarrantDescription (line 1265) only returns letter description text per stage.

steps.step: OCMS sends the request to State Courts, which processes it
steps.detail: There is no SFTP/API client to State Courts in thirdpartyapi or ocmsadminprivateapi (grep state court, ROMS, woa: 0 hits in all java/properties). Earlier court-epic findings agree: State Courts SFTP is not in the six repos. CasIntegrationController (ocmsadminapi) only accepts inbound calls from CAS/PLUS and is not credited. State Courts side: cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: OCMS marks the warrant as sent and records the reply error code
steps.detail: roms_error_code, roms_error_flag and send_to_sc_date are only fields in the UI type (Iwarrantofarrest.d.ts:21-30). No code updates these fields; there is no OcmsWarrantOfArrest entity in ocmsadminapi/src/main/java/.../crud (entity list checked, none).
